name: Camping 101: Herbalism

angles.text: As an herbalist, you can use your knowledge of plants to make Incense Candles that comfort your traveling companions at camp.
As a priest, you can rest near an Incense Candle and take heart from its fragrance during wilderness travel.
As a mage, you can benefit from an herbalist companion who makes Incense Candles for camp.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can seek Herbalist Pomeroy's instruction in Elwynn Forest.

faq.answer: Skilled herbalists can learn to make Incense Candles for campsites. Herbalist Pomeroy teaches this craft in Elwynn Forest.
Herbalist Pomeroy teaches skilled gatherers in Elwynn Forest to make Incense Candles from local plants.
faq.q: Who teaches the camping recipe for herbalists?

aliases: what do herbalists make for camping
faq.answer: Herbalists learn to make an Incense Candle. Its fragrance soothes travelers and lifts the spirits of companions who rely on mana while resting in the wild.
faq.q: What item do herbalists learn to craft from this quest?

aliases: when can i get camping 101 herbalism
faq.answer: You need skill in Herbalism and gathering before Herbalist Pomeroy will teach you camp craft.
faq.q: What are the requirements to start Camping 101: Herbalism?

faq.answer: Incense Candles soothe travelers and lift the spirits of companions who rely on mana while resting in the wild.
faq.q: Why are Incense Candles useful for adventuring parties?

aliases: where to turn in camping 101 herbalism
faq.answer: You travel to Elwynn Forest to meet Herbalist Pomeroy and learn to make campsite supplies.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

aliases: do i need herbalism for incense candle
faq.answer: No. Making an Incense Candle requires Herbalism and knowledge of wild plants and aromatic materials, which Herbalist Pomeroy teaches.
faq.q: Can non-herbalists craft the Incense Candle?

sections.body: A herbalist's craft can help a traveling party in more ways than brewing restorative draughts or selling flowers. With skill in gathering, you can help your companions endure the wilds. A camp needs more than a fire and dry bedroll. Weary travelers also need comforts that keep their minds keen. Some plants give off aromas that refresh tired minds, so herbalists can support a party far from civilization.
sections.title: Botanical Utilities for the Road

sections.body: In Elwynn Forest, Herbalist Pomeroy teaches skilled gatherers to make campsite supplies from local plants. She shows them how to shape an Incense Candle, putting herbs to use beyond alchemy flasks. Burned at camp, its fragrance soothes tired travelers and lifts the spirits of companions who rely on mana. With Pomeroy's teaching, herbalists can bring comfort to parties traveling in the wild.
sections.title: The Guidance of Herbalist Pomeroy

summary: In Elwynn Forest, Herbalist Pomeroy teaches skilled gatherers a new comfort for camp. They learn to make Incense Candles, whose fragrance lifts the spirits of spellcasters resting in the wild.
